use: Illustrative fictional room concepts; not a client project or live application output.
hero: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: hero photograph for OpenLintel, an architectural editorial website. Create one exquisite photorealistic architectural interior concept photograph, landscape 3:2. A restrained 20 square metre rectangular living room (5m wide x4m deep, ceiling 2.8m), photographed from the southeast entrance looking northwest with a natural 28mm architectural lens, straight verticals. The north wall at right of the composition has one generous centered rectangular window, thin dark bronze frame with natural foliage visible, gauzy sheer linen curtain on one side. Existing pale oak plank flooring. West wall at left is warm chalk limewash with custom pale oak low storage joinery and open shelves above, beautiful precise woodworking, small ceramics and a few books. A low warm ivory linen two-seat sofa along the east/right side foreground, one sculptural oak and linen reading chair near the window, low rounded solid oak coffee table in center, large natural undyed wool rug. Quiet morning light grazing the oak floor and putty plaster, subtle shadows, a single leafy branch in an earthenware vase, editorial material honesty. Magazine quality, exquisite but believable compact proportions, composed and intimate. Pale warm neutral color palette, no artificial orange cast, no exaggerated luxury, no ultra-wide distortion. No people, no text, no graphics, no logos. All later variants will preserve this exact room geometry and camera angle. Output one finished room image.
